description: QR 2..4 on well-conditioned matrices: factors (upstream signs), solve

format.tolerance_unit: raw units (1 ulp = 2^-32), applies to every output scalar

ops.name: qr2_q_r
ops.doc: a.qr(): (q, r) with upstream's Householder signs (diag(r) may be negative; to compare with another convention flip the sign of row i of r and column i of q)
ops.tolerance: ceil(4 + 4 * A + 4 * max |input|), A = max over outputs of sum over inputs of |d out / d in| (central differences)

ops.name: qr2_solve
ops.tolerance: ceil(4 + 4 * A), A = max over outputs of sum over inputs of |d out / d in| (central differences)
